summary: Feature request to include agent name from ADK labels in the default TemporalModel activity summary, improving traceability of multi-agent workflows in the Temporal UI timeline.
userImpact: Multi-agent ADK workflow operators cannot easily distinguish which agent performed which action in the Temporal UI timeline when all activities show identical 'invoke_model' summaries.
proposedFix: Include agent_name, agent_id, and trust_tier from llm_request.config.labels in the default activity summary (e.g., 'invoke_model: FleetAgent [T2]').
workaround: Subclass TemporalModel and extract agent name from labels manually.
resolutionDetails: Feature implemented to include agent labels in default activity summary for improved multi-agent workflow traceability and behavioral trust monitoring.
keyQuote: in multi-agent Temporal workflows, 'invoke_model' repeated 50 times gives no indication of which agent is responsible for which actions, making post-incident attribution very difficult
